decisions.reason: A simple coupling protection cap builds directly on the firm's coupling and trailer know-how and is cheap to keep in the accessory range, although its absence from the website since 2020 adds some uncertainty.

The box trailer series is core to the firm's production knowledge, so the firm can interpret market feedback and improve the line itself, even if it may be updated or renamed rather than kept unchanged.
The low-bed series draws closely on existing trailer design and production skills, and the firm's capacity to refine it makes keeping and improving the line more sensible than dropping it.
This second box trailer series fits the firm's core competence, but its overlap with Product B and its absence from the website since 2020 raise a real chance that the two lines are merged.
